release_notes.headline_internal: Durable test evidence re-resolves at acceptance; static_check accepts command proof
highlights: Acceptance re-resolves typed verification entries against current durable run records instead of trusting submit-time warnings
Earlier invalid reports no longer block when a later valid report exists
static_check tasks with command/exit_code proof no longer require adv_run_test run IDs
Agent guidance aligned: proof route selected by typed deliverable, evidence policy, and TDD intent
